title: 0:20–0:45 · Which card at Swiggy?
lede: Voiceover: “₹1,200 at Swiggy. Both cards earn ₹60, so cc-smith looks at the rest of your month: SBI Cashback's 5% covers more of your other spending, so pay with Millennia and keep SBI free. The maths is plain code; a small model only picks between the engine's figures when they differ. Every rate links to a quote on the bank's page.” No SerpApi call here: say so if asked.
